sloka: यद्यसौ तप आतिष्ठेद्भूय एवासुरेश्वर ।यावल्लोका धरिष्यन्ति तावदस्य वशानुगाः ।। ७.८४.१३ ॥
transliteration: yadyasau tapa ātiṣṭhedbhūya evāsureśvara ।yāvallokā dhariṣyanti tāvadasya vaśānugāḥ ।। 7.84.13 ॥

translations.english: O Lord of Asuras, if he performs penance again, the worlds will remain subservient to him as long as they endure.
